record.reason: The paper analyzes binary routing behavior in GPT-2 MLP activations and validates functional importance via ablations/perplexity. It proposes a characterization, not a routing optimization or measured serving/compute savings; it is only an indirect possible connection to conditional compute.
record.title: The Discrete Charm of the MLP: Binary Routing of Continuous Signals in Transformer Feed-Forward Layers
